rationale: Clauses: (1) revocation of EO 4345's withdrawal for the described tract, self-executed 1928-04-11; (2) opening to ex-service-men for 91 days beginning the 63rd day after the date, then to general public; (3) bar on rights by settlement in advance of entry. Clause 2's veteran window ran out by its own terms, but the order leaves the land open to general appropriation 'thereafter', and whether any later withdrawal or reservation closed it again is not established. No held text cites the order. Neither yes nor no is supported. Research-only proposal; text is a working text, original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
